interface.shortDescription: Track Codex work with Cicero Goals workstreams and deep Cicero Goals orchestration
interface.longDescription: Cicero Goals packages repo-local workstream tracking for Codex alongside the deeper Cicero Goals board workflow for broad, long-running, or ambiguous engineering work. It creates durable goal charters, task boards, receipts, verification gates, extension handoffs, and compatibility guidance for teams moving from Cicero Goals and goal-maker to cicero-goals.
